operator_action: Fit transport inhibit; tag deployed; restrain mechanism
inspection_criterion: Inhibit engaged; no uncontrolled arm/spring state
reject_condition: Cannot restrain or identify state

operator_action: Read pressure and use designed vent under approved procedure
tool_required: Protected gauge/indicator and approved vent tool
inspection_criterion: Zero indicated pressure and no flow
reject_condition: Pressure indication uncertain or vent damaged

operator_action: Photograph and log witnesses/lots/cycles
inspection_criterion: Complete traceable record
reject_condition: Missing identity or unexplained witness state

operator_action: Remove complete cartridge modules and segregate spent items
torque_or_control: Manufacturer removal method; no improvised leverage
inspection_criterion: Visible puncture; identity retained; no residual indication
reject_condition: Uncertain pressure state or damaged retention

operator_action: Inspect pin seat gasket thread and support; exchange module on defect
inspection_criterion: No deformation cuts corrosion contamination or looseness
reject_condition: Any pin/seat/thread/support defect

operator_action: Inspect and perform approved directional leak/flow check
inspection_criterion: Forward flow and reverse leakage within limit
reject_condition: Blocked flow reverse leak corrosion or contamination

operator_action: Install exact in-date element and indicator; record lot/expiry
inspection_criterion: Dry intact correct MPN/lot and safe indication
reject_condition: Wet expired damaged or mismatched element

operator_action: Open supplier deflation path; drain completely
inspection_criterion: No trapped pressure/water; relief path clear
reject_condition: Blocked valve/relief or retained water

operator_action: Fresh-water rinse where required and dry all cavities
inspection_criterion: Completely dry including trigger and fold interfaces
reject_condition: Moisture contamination coating tack or odor

component: Buoy fabric seams inlet relief harness
operator_action: Visual and approved low-differential leak check
inspection_criterion: No damage and leakage within released limit
reject_condition: Seam coating inlet relief or harness damage

operator_action: Inspect routing abrasion kinks corrosion and witness marks
inspection_criterion: No damage movement contamination or mixed-brand components
reject_condition: Kink abrasion corrosion loose witness or unknown assembly

operator_action: Replace single-use/time-limited seals
inspection_criterion: Correct material size lot lubrication and seating
reject_condition: Cut twisted expired substituted or contaminated seal

operator_action: Inspect and move through guarded reset travel
tool_required: Released reset tool and guarded fixture
inspection_criterion: Smooth travel; no crack bend galling play or missing capture
reject_condition: Binding deformation crack excess play or lost hardware

operator_action: Release deployed locks; inspect stops; engage stowed latches
consumable_required: Exact replaceable lock/stop module if failed
inspection_criterion: All three locks/stops/latches captive and engaged
reject_condition: Any nonpositive engagement wear deformation or missing witness

operator_action: Inspect and recompress through designed interface
torque_or_control: Released preload/travel witness; no ad hoc leverage
inspection_criterion: No corrosion crack set rubbing; latch witness complete
reject_condition: Damage abnormal set binding or uncertain preload

operator_action: Return mechanism and verify force/travel in guarded check
inspection_criterion: No leak/corrosion; force and stroke within band
reject_condition: Leak rod damage corrosion or force out of band

operator_action: Inspect leak/rod/setting and verify guarded stroke
torque_or_control: Controlled setting witness; stops 1-1.5 mm before ends
inspection_criterion: No leak/binding/corrosion and baseline force within released tolerance
reject_condition: Leak seizure setting drift corrosion or rod damage

operator_action: Fold to approved card; route lines; close pack
tool_required: Fold card pack gauge and softgoods tools
inspection_criterion: Fits gauge; unobstructed inlet/relief; closure witness complete
reject_condition: Snag excess volume twist or obstructed relief

operator_action: Verify identity/full mass/face/lot then install exact supported module
consumable_required: New accepted 86202Z cartridges; V80040 bobbins; exact gaskets/pins/clips as required
torque_or_control: Published rearm sequence; exact holder/engagement control from released work instruction
inspection_criterion: Exact MPN; mass >= marked minimum; unpunctured; correct lot/CoC status; green indicator
reject_condition: Wrong MPN underweight punctured damaged corroded expired or non-green indicator

operator_action: Verify MPN/set seal/witness and unobstructed vent; exchange module not internals
torque_or_control: Factory set/tamper seal; installation torque REQUIRED
inspection_criterion: Correct MPN/set marking/seal and clean open relief path
reject_condition: Broken seal wrong set obstruction corrosion or damage

operator_action: Run approved rated low-energy inert-gas pressure-decay test
inspection_criterion: Decay/leak within released limit; no deformation
reject_condition: Excess decay visible leak unstable indication or damage

operator_action: Verify inhibits indicators captivity and unobstructed paths without firing CO2
torque_or_control: No live cartridge discharge during routine check
inspection_criterion: All indicators/witnesses and dry functions pass
reject_condition: Any ambiguous state or failed witness/function

operator_action: Second person checks configuration and signs ready state
inspection_criterion: All lots/expiries/counts/sets/folds/locks/inhibit correct
reject_condition: Any open discrepancy or unsigned record

operator_action: Quarantine and return; no field repair
inspection_criterion: Accepted manufacturer/depot repair and requalification
reject_condition: Any unapproved field repair
